svg.title: Material, completion, and accounting close
svg.desc: Material, completion, and accounting close. Which independent branches must be summarized before a work-order comparison? Primary tables: MaterialIssue, MaterialIssueLine, ProductionCompletion, ProductionCompletionLine, WorkOrderClose. Close does not store a ProductionCompletionLineID. Aggregate issues, labor, completions, and close independently. Payroll clearing remains pooled by period/cost center.
